# Command reference

Run `vectra-axi <command> --help` for flags and examples. Deployment support below is operation-specific.

## home

Show local setup state; also the no-arguments view

Local command; no Vectra API request.

```json
{
  "command": "vectra-axi home",
  "description": "Show local setup state; also the no-arguments view",
  "flags": {
    "--help": "Show concise help; default false",
    "--profile <name>": "Select a profile by name; default environment, config default, then sole profile",
    "--config <path>": "Read an explicit config; default VECTRA_AXI_CONFIG or the platform config directory"
  },
  "combinations": [
    "--help cannot be combined with --profile",
    "--all cannot be combined with --limit"
  ],
  "examples": [
    "vectra-axi",
    "vectra-axi home",
    "vectra-axi home --profile <name>"
  ]
}
```

## doctor

Check profile configuration with one bounded detection read per QUX profile or OAuth exchange per RUX profile

- `qux.detection.list`: QUX API 2.5 bounded detection read per QUX profile
- `rux.oauth.exchange`: RUX OAuth exchange per RUX profile (no resource read)

```json
{
  "command": "vectra-axi doctor",
  "description": "Check profile configuration with one bounded detection read per QUX profile or OAuth exchange per RUX profile",
  "flags": {
    "--help": "Show concise help; default false",
    "--profile <name>": "Select a profile by name; default environment, config default, then sole profile",
    "--config <path>": "Read an explicit config; default VECTRA_AXI_CONFIG or the platform config directory"
  },
  "combinations": [
    "--help cannot be combined with --profile",
    "--all cannot be combined with --limit"
  ],
  "examples": [
    "vectra-axi doctor",
    "vectra-axi doctor --profile <name>"
  ]
}
```

## detection list

List detections on QUX v2.5 or RUX v3.4 with server-side filters and a bounded window

- `qux.detection.list`: QUX API 2.5
- `rux.detection.list`: RUX API 3.4

QUX: collection pages; bounded --all supported; RUX: collection pages; bounded --all supported

```json
{
  "command": "vectra-axi detection list",
  "description": "List detections on QUX v2.5 or RUX v3.4 with server-side filters and a bounded window",
  "pagination": "QUX: collection pages; bounded --all supported; RUX: collection pages; bounded --all supported",
  "flags": {
    "--help": "Show concise help; default false",
    "--profile <name>": "Select a profile by name; default environment, config default, then sole profile",
    "--config <path>": "Read an explicit config; default VECTRA_AXI_CONFIG or the platform config directory",
    "--state <state>": "Filter by server-side detection state",
    "--detection-type <type>": "Filter by server-side detection type",
    "--detection-category <category>": "Filter by server-side detection category",
    "--host-id <id>": "Filter by server-side host ID (non-negative integer); find it with host list --name <text>, then detection list --host-id <id>",
    "--tags <tags>": "Filter by server-side tags",
    "--certainty-gte <score>": "Filter by server-side minimum certainty",
    "--threat-gte <score>": "Filter by server-side minimum threat",
    "--ordering <ordering>": "Server-side result ordering",
    "--min-id <id>": "Server-side minimum detection ID (non-negative integer)",
    "--max-id <id>": "Server-side maximum detection ID (non-negative integer)",
    "--limit <rows>": "Row window for this read; default 100",
    "--fields <list>": "Comma-separated detection fields, including first_timestamp,last_timestamp,src_ip,src_host,summary,grouped_details; default id,detection_type,state,threat,certainty",
    "--all": "Traverse pages within 10 requests, 8 MiB, 60 seconds and 10000 rows; cannot combine with --limit",
    "--cursor <cursor>": "Resume a capped list with its original filters"
  },
  "combinations": [
    "--help cannot be combined with --profile",
    "--all cannot be combined with --limit"
  ],
  "examples": [
    "vectra-axi detection list --profile <name> --state active --limit 100",
    "vectra-axi detection list --profile <name> --threat-gte 70 --fields id,state,threat",
    "vectra-axi detection list --profile <name> --cursor <cursor>"
  ]
}
```

```json
    "--id <id>": "Detection ID to show (positive integer, required)",
    "--fields <list>": "Comma-separated projection over id,detection_type,state,threat,certainty,description,first_timestamp,last_timestamp,src_ip,src_host,summary,grouped_details",
    "--full": "Show the complete description; default previews long text"
  },
  "arguments": {
    "<id>": "Resource ID; use either a positional ID or --id, never both"

  "combinations": [

    "--all cannot be combined with --limit"
  ],
  "examples": [
    "vectra-axi detection show --profile <name> 42",
```

```json
  ]
}
```

## detection triage set

Set a QUX or RUX per-detection triage label, suppressing scoring, through the gated write pipeline

- `qux.detection.triage.set`: QUX API 2.5
- `rux.detection.triage.set`: RUX API 3.4

```json

  "command": "vectra-axi detection triage set",

  "flags": {
    "--help": "Show concise help; default false",
    "--profile <name>": "Select a profile by name; default environment, config default, then sole profile",
    "--config <path>": "Read an explicit config; default VECTRA_AXI_CONFIG or the platform config directory",
    "--ids <ids>": "Comma-separated detection IDs, normalized and capped at 100 (required)",

    "--execute": "Send the confirmed change; default previews only",

  "combinations": [
```

```json
  ]
}
```

## detection close

Close QUX (9.3+) or RUX detections as remediated or benign through the gated write pipeline

- `qux.detection.close`: QUX API 2.5
- `qux.detection.close-bulk`: QUX API 2.5
- `rux.detection.close`: RUX API 3.4
- `rux.detection.close-bulk`: RUX API 3.4

```json
{
  "command": "vectra-axi detection close",
  "description": "Close QUX (9.3+) or RUX detections as remediated or benign through the gated write pipeline",
  "flags": {
    "--help": "Show concise help; default false",
    "--profile <name>": "Select a profile by name; default environment, config default, then sole profile",
    "--config <path>": "Read an explicit config; default VECTRA_AXI_CONFIG or the platform config directory",
    "--id <id>": "Single detection ID; exactly one of --id or --ids is required",
    "--ids <ids>": "Comma-separated detection IDs, normalized and capped at 100",
    "--execute": "Send the confirmed change; default previews only",
    "--dry-run": "Preview only; cannot be combined with --execute",
    "--confirm <target>": "Exact target from the preview, required to execute a change",
    "--reason <reason>": "Close reason: remediated or benign (required)"
  },
  "arguments": {
    "<id>": "Resource ID; use either a positional ID or --id, never both"
  },
  "combinations": [
    "--help cannot be combined with --profile",
    "--all cannot be combined with --limit"
  ],
  "examples": [
    "vectra-axi detection close --profile <name> 42 --reason benign",
    "vectra-axi detection close --profile <name> --ids 41,42 --reason remediated"
  ]
}
```

```json
    "--all cannot be combined with --limit"
  ],
  "examples": [
    "vectra-axi health show --profile <name> --check cpu",
    "vectra-axi health show --profile <name> --check connectivity --fresh"
  ]
}
```

## health event list

List QUX or RUX health events from a checkpoint with a bounded window

- `qux.health.event.list`: QUX API 2.5
- `rux.health.event.list`: RUX API 3.4

QUX: checkpoint batch; --cursor/--from continuation, no --all; RUX: checkpoint batch; --cursor/--from continuation, no --all

```json
{
  "command": "vectra-axi health event list",
  "description": "List QUX or RUX health events from a checkpoint with a bounded window",
  "pagination": "QUX: checkpoint batch; --cursor/--from continuation, no --all; RUX: checkpoint batch; --cursor/--from continuation, no --all",
  "flags": {
    "--help": "Show concise help; default false",
    "--profile <name>": "Select a profile by name; default environment, config default, then sole profile",
    "--config <path>": "Read an explicit config; default VECTRA_AXI_CONFIG or the platform config directory",
    "--from <checkpoint>": "Start from a returned checkpoint; default reads the earliest batch",
    "--limit <rows>": "Row window for this read; default 100",
    "--ordering <ordering>": "Server-side result ordering",
    "--status <status>": "Filter by server-side health status",
    "--health-check-name <name>": "Filter by server-side health check name",
    "--entity-type <type>": "Filter by server-side entity type",
    "--entity-name <name>": "Filter by server-side entity name",
    "--cursor <cursor>": "Resume a capped batch with its original filters"
  },
  "combinations": [
    "--help cannot be combined with --profile",
    "--all cannot be combined with --limit"
  ],
  "examples": [
    "vectra-axi health event list --profile <name>",
    "vectra-axi health event list --profile <name> --from <checkpoint> --limit 20",
    "vectra-axi health event list --profile <name> --cursor <cursor>"
  ]
}
```

## api get

Read one allowlisted GET operation by inventory ID with its recorded query and field policy

Network command; reads one allowlisted QUX or RUX GET operation through the configured profile.

```json
{
  "command": "vectra-axi api get",
  "description": "Read one allowlisted GET operation by inventory ID with its recorded query and field policy",
  "flags": {
    "--help": "Show concise help; default false",
    "--profile <name>": "Select a profile by name; default environment, config default, then sole profile",
    "--config <path>": "Read an explicit config; default VECTRA_AXI_CONFIG or the platform config directory",
    "--operation <id>": "Reviewed operation ID to read, for example qux.detection.list (required)",
    "--path <pairs>": "Route template bindings as name=value pairs joined with &",
    "--query <pairs>": "Server-side filters as name=value pairs joined with &",
    "--fields <list>": "Comma-separated projection over the operation's recorded fields",
    "--limit <rows>": "Row window for collection reads; default 100",
    "--cursor <cursor>": "Resume a capped collection read with its original operation and filters",
    "--full": "Show complete long text; default previews truncated values"
  },
  "combinations": [
    "--help cannot be combined with --profile",
    "--all cannot be combined with --limit"
  ],
  "examples": [
    "vectra-axi api get --profile <name> --operation qux.detection.list --query state=active --limit 20",
    "vectra-axi api get --profile <name> --operation qux.detection.show --path id=42",
    "vectra-axi api get --profile <name> --operation rux.detection.list --fields id,state"
  ]
}
```

## lockdown list

List QUX host/account or RUX host/account/traffic lockdown status

- `qux.lockdown.host.list`: QUX API 2.5
- `qux.lockdown.account.list`: QUX API 2.5
- `rux.lockdown.list`: RUX API 3.4

QUX: nonpaged single response; no --all; RUX: nonpaged single response; no --all

```json
{
  "command": "vectra-axi lockdown list",
  "description": "List QUX host/account or RUX host/account/traffic lockdown status",
  "pagination": "QUX: nonpaged single response; no --all; RUX: nonpaged single response; no --all",
  "flags": {
    "--help": "Show concise help; default false",
    "--profile <name>": "Select a profile by name; default environment, config default, then sole profile",
    "--config <path>": "Read an explicit config; default VECTRA_AXI_CONFIG or the platform config directory",
    "--type <kind>": "Lockdown status kind: host, account, or traffic on a RUX profile (required)"
  },
  "combinations": [
    "--help cannot be combined with --profile",
    "--all cannot be combined with --limit"
  ],
  "examples": [
    "vectra-axi lockdown list --profile <name> --type host",
    "vectra-axi lockdown list --profile <name> --type account"
  ]
}
```
